sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
This Request for Tender (RFT) seeks the supply, support and ongoing management of Water Delivery, Drafting and Supply Equipment for the NSW RFS.
The objectives of this RFT are to:
a)Establish one or more standing supply agreements or category-based panel arrangements
b)Obtain safe, compliant and fit for purpose equipment
c)Standardise equipment and improve interoperability across appliances, pumps, districts and agencies
d)Improve suppression effectiveness, firefighter safety and operational resilience
e)Ensure continuity of supply, emergency response capability and seasonal surge capacity
f)Improve product durability, repairability, lifecycle support and value for money
g)Support consistent training, maintenance, product data and asset management
h)Enable innovation and future product development throughout the Contract term.
Please proceed to Coupa via the link provided to view and download all tender documents
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
Category:
- Hoses
- Branches, Nozzles and Valves
- Couplings and Storz Fittings
- Monitors
- Drafting Equipment
- Inductors and Foam Accessories
- Standpipes, Tools and Accessories
- Spares, Consumables and Lifecycle Support
The Scope of Works also includes the delivery of:
- Product selection and configuration support
- Technical data, product images and catalogue-ready information
- User, maintenance, inspection and safe operating guidance
- Training and product familiarisation materials
- Storage, cleaning, decontamination, disposal and recycling guidance
- Spare parts, repair systems, accessories and consumables
- Warranty, defect, returns and recall management
- Supply chain reporting, including DIFOT, stock outages and continuity risks
- Lifecycle support, product change control and transition-out planning

Instructions-Accessing Tender Documents and Submitting a Response
To access the Tender documents and submit a Tender Response, Tenderers must first select “Request Participation” for the public event they wish to participate in.
Once participation has been requested, Tenderers must:
1.Go to the Event Info page in the Coupa Sourcing event.
2.Answer the required participation question by selecting the appropriate response from the drop-down menu: “Do you intend to participate?”
3.Read and accept the Tender Terms and Conditions.
4.Once the above steps have been completed, the “Enter Response” button at the bottom of the page will become active (blue).
5.Select “Enter Response” to access, view and download all Tender documents and submit your Tender Response.
